  "rationales": {
    "LC": "Attacker-controlled instructions enter through a fetched travel page and redirect wallet access and outbound transmission, rather than arriving as a privileged user instruction. This indirect path is documented in damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/docs/demo/FLIGHT_RUN_SCRIPT.md:25-59 and damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:450-483.",
    "CP": "The FlightBot path processes the current URL and fetched page within one request, with its source cache disabled by default; retaining or re-fetching source content would not establish agent-memory persistence. The latest-turn handling and separate MemoryBot instruction store support N rather than session or cross-session memory (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:980-1092, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:159-160).",
    "AP": "Influence relays from web-fetch processing into the wallet and outbound-tool workflow within the same FlightBot process and principal. The documented path does not delegate compromised authority to another agent or tenant; transmitting data to a collector is not itself lateral agent propagation (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:450-483, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190).",
    "RH": "The path reaches an internal success evaluator: it marks the attack successful and updates successful-category tracking before executing the outbound request. This supports possible evaluator manipulation, but the briefing supplies no verified reward-hacking episode; successful wallet exfiltration alone is not such verification (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190).",
    "ES": "Although the tool operations are scripted, the fetched page supplies the callback destination, and unprotected FlightBot has no independent egress grant constraining that wallet-bearing request. This unconstrained security-relevant argument supports W without importing unrelated PluginBot capabilities (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-flight-mirror.js:43-65, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:450-483, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190).",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding makes AV:L appropriate, despite permissive agent CORS; the documented traveler submission of the crafted URL requires UI:A, while the attacker needs no agent privileges, security-control bypass, or additional deployment condition (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/docs/demo/FLIGHT_RUN_SCRIPT.md:25-59). Disclosure of the saved payment and identity wallet supports VC:H, and unauthorized redirection of the booking/tool workflow supports limited VI:L, with no demonstrated availability loss (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:450-483, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190). The wallet belongs to the traveler, not the attacker; the attacker owns the poisoned page and receiving endpoint, and the documented path establishes no additional confidentiality, integrity, or availability loss in a subsequent system (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-flight-mirror.js:43-65, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/docs/demo/FLIGHT_RUN_SCRIPT.md:25-59)."
  },

Fetching, wallet substitution, and transmission are automatic afterward, but that does not automate the required victim action (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/docs/demo/FLIGHT_RUN_SCRIPT.md:25-59, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190).",

  "technical_impact_rationale": "The path discloses the complete saved wallet and redirects a bounded tool workflow, but it does not establish arbitrary code execution, persistent control of FlightBot, or access to all fleet assets. High confidentiality impact on this particular wallet therefore does not imply total compromise of the vulnerable system (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:450-483, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190).",

Application code nevertheless conditionally selects and sequences the URL fetch and wallet-bearing callback; this is scripted action sequencing, not model-directed planning (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/llm/provider.js:60-63, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:980-1092, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1149-1190)."
